issues.detail: Hebrew 'הַרְגִּשׁוּ' means 'rushed/stormed in' (from רגשׁ, to make a noise/commotion), not 'nhóm lại' (gathered together). The sense of a hostile, sudden rush is lost.
Hebrew 'וְהַשְׁכַּחוּ' (from שכח, to find) means 'and found' Daniel, not 'và thấy' (and saw). 'Found' implies a deliberate search, whereas 'saw' is more incidental.
